verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph documents a driveItem search API that queries items matching a query across a folder hierarchy, a whole drive, or files shared with the user. That confirms a first-party programmatic search endpoint. However, the evidence never says whether the query matches full-text file contents or only filenames/metadata, which is the core of this story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that search indexes file contents (full-text), details on matching semantics beyond prefix matching, and independent or hands-on corroboration of content search results.
